products.name: Bark for Schools
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Monitoring of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. Use: Student safety monitoring. Who: District administrators. Student age: School accounts. Privacy: Not verified. Price: Not verified. Caution: Vendor comparison page only.

reading.body:
Bark Technologies sells AI content monitoring to families and schools, and the public record here contains no verified privacy or pricing terms for either.

The consumer product scans text, images, video, and audio across social media, messages, posts, comments, replies, and web searches, in English, Spanish, and Afrikaans, and alerts parents to what it flags. The school product applies the same monitoring idea to Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 accounts, sold to district administrators. Both are monitoring layers that sit on top of platforms the company does not own.

For AI specifically, this is a demand-side story rather than a compute one. The data records no data centers, no power contracts, no chip procurement, and no model training of its own, so nothing here speaks to the grid constraint. What it does show is that surveillance-style inference is being packaged for two markets with very different tolerances for error, a household and a school district.

The record is thin in ways worth naming. There are no lawsuits or filings, no MCP server, and the schools entry is flagged as a vendor comparison page with privacy and pricing unverified. A reader should treat the capability claims as the company's own description, not as audited fact.

profile_text.body:
Bark Technologies operates the website bark.us, where it describes itself as offering parental controls for families. According to the site, the service helps parents monitor social media, manage screen time, and track location. Once connected, the company says its AI scans text, images, video, and audio for potential dangers, including conversations in English, Spanish, and Afrikaans, and sends alerts when it finds something concerning. The site states that its content monitoring scans messages, posts, comments, replies, and web searches.

The company also offers a product tracked as Bark for Schools, listed under an education and research AI category, with a page at bark.us/schools/. It is described as monitoring Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 for student safety, aimed at district administrators and school accounts. The available note characterizes the schools page as a vendor comparison page, and states that privacy and pricing details were not verified.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
